messages:
alejandra: FYI I opened a docs PR to add Acadia-13B (int8) to the model catalog. It includes a limits table, a short migration guide, and SDK examples for batched embeddings. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4872
sam: sweet. can you paste the perf numbers you used for the limits table?
kevin: ran micro-bench on p4d. rough numbers: p50 latency ~45ms for 512 tokens (batch=4), throughput ~140 tok/s (batch=8). memory fits 48GB with Q4 int8. gist with full runs: https://gist.github.com/kevin/abcd1234
mahmoud: quick note — link-checker flagged a relative link in the migration guide: `../models/acadia` -> 404. need absolute path or proper slug.
docs-bot: Link check failed: /docs/models/acadia -> 404 (file missing)
jon: compatibility note: Acadia-13B-int8 uses KV cache layout v2. runtimes <3.1 won't load the quantized blob. We should add an explicit compatibility row and mention auto-fallback to the fp16 variant.
alejandra: good call. I'll add a "Runtime compatibility" subsection that says if runtime <3.1, requests will automatically route to Acadia-13B-fp16 and warn in logs. any preferred phrasing for the auto-fallback?
sam: short & clear: `Runtime < 3.1: not supported. Requests will auto-fallback to Acadia-13B-fp16. Upgrade runtime to use int8.`
kevin: for the limits table please add: `max sequence: 8192 (recommended 4096 for sustained throughput)`, and mark the memory footprint tested on p4d. Also change general term "quantized" to "int8 (Q4)" for clarity.
mahmoud: snippet for Python SDK (embeddings, batched) — feel free to drop into the PR:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
texts = ["short text 1", "another text"]
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="acadia-13b-int8", input=texts, batch_size=8)
print([e.vector for e in resp.data])
```
JS snippet too:
```javascript
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk'
const client = new Redwood()
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'acadia-13b-int8', input: ['a','b'], batchSize: 8 })
console.log(resp.data.map(d => d.vector))
```
alejandra: perfect, thanks — I'll add both and fix the relative link to `/models/acadia` (perma). tagging reviewers: @sam @kevin @mahmoud
sam: LGTM. I'll give a full review tomorrow morning :thumbsup:
kevin: tiny nit: in the migration guide, under "behavior changes" change "quantized" -> "int8 (Q4)" and add a short sentence about potential tokenization parity differences.
mahmoud: pushed a formatting commit to the snippet block (fixed code fence language and linewrap).
docs-bot: PR updated, running checks (link-check, lint, build)
deploy-bot: docs build passed — staging available at https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/models/acadia
alejandra: thanks everyone — I'll merge after sam's review and follow up to confirm no runtime regressions.
